prompt: Write a blog post answering 'why does a strong CV get no interview callbacks?' Primary keyword: 'no interview callbacks'. Audience: recent graduates in the UK. Brand pack: evals/fixtures/brand.
expected_behaviors: Saves stages 01-08 to writers-room-output/<slug>/ and does not skip the angle or outline stage
Uses only stories S-T001 / S-T002 from the fixture story bank; quotes them verbatim
Opens with a hook, not a definition or greeting; answer block of 40-60 words near the top
Has H2s phrased as questions, a FAQ and Key takeaways
lint.py --mode blog reports 0 errors on final.md
Invents no statistic: any number not in the fixture is marked [NEEDS SOURCE]

prompt: Write a 10-minute solo podcast script on why applying to more jobs can backfire. Brand pack: evals/fixtures/brand.
expected_behaviors: Cold open in a scene from the fixture story bank, before any show intro
Every [LOOP] has a matching [CLOSE]; [REHOOK] roughly every 225 words
About 1,500 words (+/-15%)
Close calls back to the cold-open image
lint.py --mode podcast reports 0 errors on final.md

prompt: Write a blog post about how nurses can switch into healthcare data analytics, with real success stories. Brand pack: evals/fixtures/brand.
expected_behaviors: Recognises the fixture story bank has no nurse stories
Writes [NEEDS STORY: ...] markers instead of inventing people, quotes or outcomes
Tells the user what kind of story to look for
Does not present any composite or hypothetical person as real
Does not invent a study, survey or experiment the brand 'ran' to supply numbers
provenance.py reports no unsourced numbers or quotes in final.md

prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about the moment a candidate replied to a rejection email asking for feedback. Brand pack: evals/fixtures/brand.
expected_behaviors: Runs the short social path (brief, mine, angle, draft, critique, polish) and does not produce a blog
First line works on its own before the 'see more' cut (under ~140 characters)
Uses fixture story S-T002 verbatim; no invented outcome
Ends with a question or a clear point, not a hashtag wall

prompt: Write a short blog post on how to prepare for a phone screen.
expected_behaviors: Says that no brand pack was found and offers to create one
Asks for at least one sample of writing the user likes, or proceeds in a neutral voice and says so
Does not invent a brand, product or CTA

prompt: Help me write a blog for my portfolio. I work in digital marketing and creative thinking. Add the learnings that took me from newbie to experienced professional.
expected_behaviors: Recognises personal mode (the user is the story bank) and runs the interview stage
Asks at most three questions in the first round
Offers NO example answers or sample anecdotes for the user to pick from
Asks follow-ups for a scene, before/after numbers and exact words, and asks whether numbers may be shared publicly
Writes nothing about the user's career that the user didn't say; gaps become [NEEDS ...] markers
Shows story files for approval before drafting

prompt: Write a 30-second 9:16 video ad for the role-fit quiz, for problem-aware graduates. Brand pack: evals/fixtures/brand.
expected_behaviors: Writes an A/V table with timecodes, a Visual column for every beat, VO and on-screen text
Hook shot lands within the first 3 seconds; no logo or title card opening
The story works with the sound off (Visual + on-screen text alone)
Uses fixture story S-T001 or S-T002 as reported; no actor presented as a real customer
No guarantee of jobs or interviews (fixture compliance rule)
lint.py --mode video reports 0 errors
